# Ivan Ramler {.biography-name}

**Professor of Statistics and Data Science**  
[St. Lawrence University](https://www.stlawu.edu/){target="_blank"}

I am a Professor of Statistics and Data Science in the [Department of Mathematics, Computer Science, and Statistics](https://www.stlawu.edu/offices/math-computer-science-and-statistics){target="_blank"} at St. Lawrence University. My professional interests include statistics education, sports analytics, and statistical applications to the biological and environmental sciences.

Much of my scholarly activity focuses on creating educational resources that make statistical thinking accessible and relevant. This includes my work with the [SCORE Network](https://www.scorenetwork.org/){target="_blank"} and contributions to [*What's Going On in This Graph?*](https://www.nytimes.com/column/whats-going-on-in-this-graph){target="_blank"}, a feature of The New York Times Learning Network.
